intent: Record why Phase 2 could not run on the Customer 0 account. This is a product finding, not a claim about the gateway.

execution.command: alchemy dev --stage mcp_trust_p2 with ALCHEMY_PROFILE=customer0, then calls through the local Gateway, Acme and Agent Workers
execution.note: Observed by this session: the two Alchemy findings. Reported by the orchestrator and not reproduced here: the two wrangler findings.

alchemyCustomer0Profile.namespaceCreate: ok: two namespaces were created in Customer 0
alchemyCustomer0Profile.kvGetPutDeleteFromWorker: failed: 403 Forbidden on every operation (NamespaceError: KV GET, PUT and DELETE failed: 403 Forbidden)

alchemyDefaultProfileAgentExperience.workersAiFromWorker: ok: real model reply with a neurons figure

reportedByOrchestratorNotReproduced.wrangler_customer0_kv: put, get and delete ok. So the KV 403 comes from the Alchemy customer0 profile grant, not from the account.
reportedByOrchestratorNotReproduced.wrangler_customer0_workers_ai: error 1050. So the Customer 0 account lacks Workers AI.

projected.interpretation: Two separate causes: an OAuth grant in the Alchemy profile that cannot reach KV from a Worker, and an account without Workers AI. Neither was confirmed by reading credentials. Neither is a defect in the gateway.

constraintCleared.constraint: No Cloudflare resources other than local dev resources and the two scratch KV namespaces
constraintCleared.how: Namespaces created on Customer 0 and on Agent Experience by this session were deleted. The two namespaces now in use are mcp-trust-scratch and mcp-trust-decoy on Agent Experience.

cost.note: A few Workers AI calls ran under the Agent Experience account before the account problem was found: about 5 calls, roughly 80 neurons.
